what: A cut-out figure hidden under the frame rises when it enters the screen minus the bottom 20%, overshooting slightly from below 100% over .4s with cubic-bezier(.34,1.24,.64,1), .5s later a side speech bubble pops out from 0 over .45s with cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) (once). A staff member or mascot saying Let’s get to work today! — for sidebar, section-end and Footer spots.

options.[data-fx-part=person]: Cell wrapping the person — its first child (cutout image) rises. The cell becomes overflow: hidden
options.[data-fx-part=balloon]: Speech bubble — pops out from 0 (pick both, if one is missing, only the existing one)
options.on: If “load,” right on open (first-screen sidebar), default is when visible
options.margin: Offset from the bottom of the screen, default -20%
options.--fx-person-dur · --fx-person-delay · --: Character pop-up duration, delay and curve (via style), default .4s · 0s · cubic-bezier(.34,1.24,.64,1)
options.--fx-balloon-dur · --fx-balloon-delay ·: Speech bubble length, delay and curve, default .45s · .5s · cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)
options.--fx-origin: Origin point where the speech bubble scales, default 0% 100% (tail side)

note: The person slot rises even as a gray placeholder (wf-img). With reduced motion, everything is visible from the start
use: Your quick word here!
